proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

If you’d like to see the Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) for the past two months, you could try one of the following approaches:

| Option | How to do it |
|--------|--------------|
| **Yahoo Finance CSV download** | Use a URL like `https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/^IXIC?period1=1685145600&period2=1690416000&interval=1d&events=history&includeAdjustedClose=true` (replace the timestamps with the exact Unix times for your desired date range). |
| **Alpha Vantage API** | Sign up for a free API key at [alphavantage.co](https://www.alphavantage.co/) and call `https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY_ADJUSTED&symbol=^IXIC&apikey=YOUR_KEY`. |
| **Python libraries** | Use `yfinance` (`pip install yfinance`) and run `import yfinance as yf; df = yf.download("^IXIC", start="2026-05-27", end="2026-07-27")`. |
| **Web scraping** | Scrape a finance site (e.g., MarketWatch, Bloomberg) for the historical table, though this may violate terms of service. |

Let me know if you’d like help constructing a specific request or script for any of these options!
